headline: Chamath Palihapitiya raises $135M for AI coding startup as CEO
summary: 8090 Labs, founded by Chamath Palihapitiya, raised $135M Series A for its AI coding agent. Palihapitiya takes CEO role.
details: Chamath Palihapitiya, known for Social Capital and the All-In podcast, announced that his AI coding startup, 8090 Labs, raised a $135 million Series A round. The funding was led by Salesforce Ventures with participation from several notable investors.

The company, founded in January 2024, offers an AI coding agent called Software Factory, designed for corporate programming teams. This tool helps coders build production-quality software using AI, with features like audit trails for enterprise control.

With this raise, Palihapitiya will lead 8090 Labs as CEO, a role he previously said was a return to a full-time operating position, much like his early days at Facebook. He likens the current AI surge to the rise of social media in his career.

headline: Uber ends Waymo ride partnership in Phoenix no longer offering joint service
summary: Uber and Waymo end partnership in Phoenix. Waymo continues autonomous rides through its own app.
details: Uber and Waymo have ended their partnership in Phoenix, Arizona. The two companies had been working together for almost three years.
Waymo will continue to offer rides through its own app in Phoenix. The company has a long history in the city, using its streets as a testing ground before launching public rides in 2020.
Uber may focus on its own autonomous vehicle operations. The company has been building its own robotaxi fleet and has worked with several brands to offer driverless rides.
